chains.title: Loss of ARID5B repression raises both IRX3 and IRX5

links.claim: ARID5B is the leading TF based on reported allele-specific binding at this site; the ref T allele binds more strongly than alt C. I do not know of a verified QBiC-SELEX model for ARID5B here.
The variant lies in an intronic enhancer at the FTO locus, and loss of ARID5B binding on C weakens repression of that element.
The enhancer affects both IRX3 and IRX5, with expression of both genes rising on the C allele.
The effect occurs in adipocyte progenitors, where increased IRX3 and IRX5 jointly shift cells away from thermogenic differentiation.
Reduced thermogenic capacity contributes to increased obesity risk.

predictions: In isogenic C-allele cells, both IRX3 and IRX5 expression rise.
Restoring ARID5B occupancy or activity at the element reduces expression of both genes.
falsified_if: The C allele does not reduce ARID5B binding in relevant adipocyte progenitors.
Precise T-to-C editing reproducibly changes only one of IRX3 or IRX5, with no effect on the other.

chains.title: Loss of ARID5B repression primarily raises IRX3

links.claim: ARID5B is the leading TF based on reported allele-specific binding at this site; the ref T allele binds more strongly than alt C. I do not know of a verified QBiC-SELEX model for ARID5B here.
The variant lies in an intronic enhancer at the FTO locus, and loss of ARID5B binding on C weakens repression of that element.
The enhancer's principal affected target is IRX3, whose expression rises on the C allele.
The effect occurs in adipocyte progenitors, where increased IRX3 shifts cells away from thermogenic differentiation.
Reduced thermogenic capacity contributes to increased obesity risk.

predictions: In isogenic C-allele cells, IRX3 expression rises more consistently than IRX5 expression.
Restoring ARID5B occupancy or activity at the element reduces the IRX3 increase.
falsified_if: The C allele does not reduce ARID5B binding in relevant adipocyte progenitors.
Precise T-to-C editing does not increase IRX3 expression in those cells.

chains.title: No TF-mediated effect of rs1421085
predictions: Precise editing of rs1421085 alone produces no reproducible change in IRX3 or IRX5 expression in relevant cells.
Any association with obesity is explained by linkage to another causal variant or by a non-causal association.
falsified_if: Precise editing produces a reproducible allele-dependent effect on TF occupancy and downstream gene expression in relevant cells.

matrix.test: Precisely edit T to C in adipocyte progenitors and measure IRX3 and IRX5 RNA by targeted RT-qPCR.

outcomes.outcome: IRX3 rises more consistently than IRX5.
IRX5 rises more consistently than IRX3.
Neither gene shows a reproducible edit-dependent change.

matrix.test: Measure ARID5B occupancy at the variant in matched T/T and C/C adipocyte progenitors.

outcomes.outcome: Occupancy is higher on T than C.
Occupancy is higher on T than C.
Occupancy is higher on T than C.
No reproducible allele-dependent ARID5B occupancy difference.

next_experiment: Precisely edit T to C in adipocyte progenitors and use targeted RT-qPCR to measure IRX3 and IRX5. Both increasing supports the highest-probability dual-target chain; an IRX3-selective increase supports the runner-up.
